description: DeepECG-SSL fine-tuned in CLSA for incident CVD by Follow-up 2 (median 5.8 y). Ensemble of 5 cross-validation fold models.

input.lead_order: I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1-V6

model_A_plus.formula: logit(risk) = intercept + b_ecg*ecg_logit + b_age*age + b_female*female + b_htn*hypertension
model_A_plus.ecg_logit: logit of the mean over folds of Platt-calibrated fold probabilities

model_ecg_age_sex_external.ecg_logit_uncal: logit of the mean over the 5 folds of UNCALIBRATED fold sigmoid outputs
model_ecg_age_sex_external.use: validated at MHI (no hypertension variable); fitted on CLSA development out-of-fold predictions, applied unchanged. Overpredicts at MHI (slope 0.81, CITL -0.66): recalibrate locally.

parameter_provenance: Full-precision development-only logistic fits reproduced from the original recipe; every coefficient rounds to the original four-decimal coefficient; A+ verified against all 3906 saved test outputs.
